description: WEDISTRICT Lulea Demosite Operational Data is provided by RISE Research Institutes of Sweden. RISE publishes operational measurements from the WEDISTRICT Luleå demonstrator, combining biogas solid-oxide fuel cells, an immersion-cooled micro data centre and heat recovery for a neighbouring building. Geographic context: site; Lulea, Sweden. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: not established on the reviewed page. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the Zenodo record on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. This is one project demonstrator. Its operating conditions and study-specific data require approval under Q2 before inclusion. Potential simulation use: Calibrate coupled computing, power and recovered-heat models.
